criteria: both answers read by hand and judged correct/useful for the question as asked
Head Start actually faster on this run (numbers copied from the run, never edited)
variety: 10 different kinds, 5 of the 6 voices, 3.1-4.4 s of speech
>=2 with fillers (sc13 'uh', sc25 'so, um'); no self-correction qualified (see excluded)
>=3 current/sports/weather (sc05 news, sc30 sports, sc01 weather)
